t: Islam is built on five pillars.
f: Islam is built on seven pillars.
x: The Prophet ﷺ said Islam is built on five.

t: There are five obligatory prayers each day.
f: There are three obligatory prayers each day.
x: Five prayers are obligatory every day and night.

t: Fasting in Ramadan is one of the pillars of Islam.
f: Fasting in Shawwal is one of the pillars of Islam.
x: The pillar is fasting Ramadan, not Shawwal.

t: Hajj is obligatory once in a lifetime for those who are able.
f: Hajj is obligatory every year for those who are able.
x: Hajj is due once in a lifetime on those able to make the journey.

t: The Qur'an was revealed in the month of Ramadan.
f: The Qur'an was first revealed in the month of Muharram.
x: Allah says Ramadan is the month in which the Qur'an was revealed.

t: The Qur'an has 114 surahs.
f: The Qur'an has 124 surahs.
x: The Qur'an has 114 surahs.

t: Al-Fatihah is the first surah of the mushaf.
f: Al-Baqarah is the first surah of the mushaf.
x: Al-Fatihah opens the mushaf. Al-Baqarah is the second surah.

t: Al-Fatihah has seven ayat.
f: Al-Fatihah has five ayat.
x: Al-Fatihah has seven ayat.

t: Al-Baqarah is the longest surah in the Qur'an.
f: Ali 'Imran is the longest surah in the Qur'an.
x: Al-Baqarah, with 286 ayat, is the longest surah.

t: Al-Kawthar is the shortest surah, with three ayat.
f: Al-Ikhlas is the shortest surah, with two ayat.
x: Al-Kawthar is the shortest surah. Al-Ikhlas has four ayat.

t: An-Nas is the last surah of the mushaf.
f: Al-Falaq is the last surah of the mushaf.
x: An-Nas is the last surah. Al-Falaq comes just before it.

t: The Qur'an is divided into 30 juz.
f: The Qur'an is divided into 40 juz.
x: The Qur'an is divided into thirty parts (juz).

t: Jibril brought the revelation to the Prophet ﷺ.
f: Mika'il brought the revelation to the Prophet ﷺ.
x: Jibril (Gabriel) brought the Qur'an down to the Prophet's heart.

t: The first word revealed was "Read" (Iqra').
f: The first word revealed was "Say" (Qul).
x: The first revelation began, "Read in the name of your Lord."

t: The first revelation came in the cave of Hira.
f: The first revelation came in the cave of Thawr.
x: Revelation began in the cave of Hira. Thawr is where the Prophet ﷺ hid during the Hijrah.

t: The Prophet ﷺ was born in Makkah.
f: The Prophet ﷺ was born in Madinah.
x: He was born in Makkah and migrated to Madinah later.

t: The Prophet's mother was Aminah.
f: The Prophet's mother was Halimah.
x: His mother was Aminah bint Wahb. Halimah was his wet nurse.

t: Khadijah was the Prophet's first wife.
f: Aishah was the Prophet's first wife.
x: Khadijah was his first wife. He married Aishah after Khadijah's death.

t: Abu Bakr was the first caliph.
f: Umar was the first caliph.
x: Abu Bakr was the first caliph, Umar the second.

t: Ali ibn Abi Talib was the fourth caliph.
f: Ali ibn Abi Talib was the second caliph.
x: The order was Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman, then Ali.

t: Bilal was the first muezzin of Islam.
f: Abu Hurayrah was the first muezzin of Islam.
x: The Prophet ﷺ told Bilal to call the adhan.

t: The Hijrah was the migration from Makkah to Madinah.
f: The Hijrah was the migration from Madinah to Makkah.
x: The Prophet ﷺ migrated from Makkah to Madinah.

t: The Islamic calendar begins with the Hijrah.
f: The Islamic calendar begins with the Prophet's birth.
x: The companions began counting years from the Hijrah.

t: The Islamic calendar is lunar.
f: The Islamic calendar is solar.
x: The months follow the moon. Allah says the new moons are signs of time for people and for Hajj.

t: Muslims pray facing the Ka'bah.
f: Muslims pray facing Masjid an-Nabawi.
x: The qiblah is the Ka'bah in the Masjid al-Haram.

t: The Ka'bah is in Makkah.
f: The Ka'bah is in Jerusalem.
x: The Ka'bah is in Makkah. Masjid al-Aqsa is in Jerusalem.

t: Ibrahim and Isma'il raised the foundations of the Ka'bah.
f: Musa and Harun raised the foundations of the Ka'bah.
x: Allah says Ibrahim and Isma'il raised the foundations of the House.

t: Zamzam water is in Makkah.
f: Zamzam water is in Madinah.
x: The well of Zamzam is in Makkah, near the Ka'bah.

t: Wudu is required before the prayer.
f: Wudu is required before reading a hadith book.
x: The Prophet ﷺ said no prayer is accepted without purification.

t: Washing the face is part of wudu.
f: Washing the whole body is part of wudu.
x: Wudu is washing the face, arms, wiping the head and washing the feet. Washing the whole body is ghusl.

t: Tayammum uses clean earth when water cannot be found.
f: Tayammum uses milk when water cannot be found.
x: Allah says if you find no water, use clean earth.

t: Fajr has two rak'ahs.
f: Fajr has four rak'ahs.
x: Fajr has two rak'ahs.

t: Maghrib has three rak'ahs.
f: Maghrib has two rak'ahs.
x: Maghrib is the prayer of three rak'ahs.

t: Dhuhr has four rak'ahs.
f: Dhuhr has three rak'ahs.
x: Dhuhr has four rak'ahs.

t: Jumu'ah prayer is on Friday.
f: Jumu'ah prayer is on Monday.
x: Allah commands hurrying to remembrance when the call is made on Friday.

t: Eid al-Fitr comes at the end of Ramadan.
f: Eid al-Fitr comes at the end of Dhul-Hijjah.
x: Eid al-Fitr is on the 1st of Shawwal, after Ramadan.

t: Eid al-Adha falls in Dhul-Hijjah.
f: Eid al-Adha falls in Rajab.
x: Eid al-Adha is on the 10th of Dhul-Hijjah.

t: Zakat is a pillar of Islam.
f: Umrah is a pillar of Islam.
x: Zakat is one of the five pillars. Umrah is not among them.

t: Laylat al-Qadr is better than a thousand months.
f: Laylat al-Qadr is better than a hundred months.
x: Surah Al-Qadr says it is better than a thousand months.

t: Laylat al-Qadr is sought in the last ten nights of Ramadan.
f: Laylat al-Qadr is sought in the first ten nights of Ramadan.
x: The Prophet ﷺ said to seek it in the odd nights of the last ten.

t: Suhur is the meal before dawn.
f: Suhur is the meal after sunset.
x: Suhur is eaten before dawn. The meal at sunset is iftar.

t: The Prophet ﷺ said there is blessing in suhur.
f: The Prophet ﷺ said suhur should be avoided.
x: He said, "Take suhur, for in suhur there is blessing."

t: People who are fasting should hurry to break the fast at sunset.
f: People who are fasting should wait an hour after sunset to break the fast.
x: The Prophet ﷺ said people will remain upon good as long as they hurry to break the fast.

t: Musa was given the Tawrat.
f: Musa was given the Injil.
x: The Tawrat was given to Musa. The Injil was given to Isa.

t: Dawud was given the Zabur.
f: Dawud was given the Tawrat.
x: Allah says He gave Dawud the Zabur (Psalms).

t: Isa was born to Maryam without a father.
f: Isa was the son of Zakariyya.
x: Isa was born to Maryam miraculously. Zakariyya's son was Yahya.

t: Nuh built the Ark.
f: Ibrahim built the Ark.
x: Allah told Nuh to build the ship.

t: Yunus was swallowed by a great fish.
f: Yusuf was swallowed by a great fish.
x: Yunus was swallowed by the fish. Yusuf was thrown into a well.

t: Yusuf was thrown into a well by his brothers.
f: Yusuf was thrown into the sea by his brothers.
x: Yusuf's brothers threw him into the depths of a well.

t: Ibrahim was thrown into a fire and was not harmed.
f: Ibrahim was thrown into the sea and was not harmed.
x: Allah said, "O fire, be coolness and safety for Ibrahim."

t: Musa's staff turned into a snake.
f: Isa's staff turned into a snake.
x: It was Musa's staff that became a serpent.

t: Sulayman could understand the speech of birds.
f: Nuh could understand the speech of birds.
x: Sulayman said, "We have been taught the language of birds."

t: Adam was the first human being.
f: Nuh was the first human being.
x: Allah created Adam first, and from him his mate.

t: Iblis refused to bow down to Adam.
f: Jibril refused to bow down to Adam.
x: All the angels bowed except Iblis.

t: Isma'il was the son of Ibrahim and Hajar.
f: Isma'il was the son of Ibrahim and Sarah.
x: Isma'il's mother was Hajar. Ishaq's mother was Sarah.

t: Harun was the brother of Musa.
f: Harun was the father of Musa.
x: Musa asked Allah to strengthen him with his brother Harun.

t: Ya'qub was the father of Yusuf.
f: Ishaq was the father of Yusuf.
x: Yusuf's father was Ya'qub, son of Ishaq.

t: Maryam is the only woman named in the Qur'an.
f: Khadijah is the only woman named in the Qur'an.
x: Maryam is the only woman mentioned by name, and a surah is named after her.

t: Surah Yusuf tells one prophet's story from start to end.
f: Surah Yusuf tells the story of Nuh.
x: Surah Yusuf tells the story of Yusuf in one surah.

t: Muhammad ﷺ is the last prophet.
f: Isa is the last prophet.
x: The Qur'an calls Muhammad ﷺ the Seal of the Prophets.

t: Surah Al-Ikhlas describes the oneness of Allah.
f: Surah Al-Ikhlas describes the Day of Judgement.
x: Al-Ikhlas says, "Say: He is Allah, the One."

t: Ayat al-Kursi is in Surah Al-Baqarah.
f: Ayat al-Kursi is in Surah Ali 'Imran.
x: Ayat al-Kursi is verse 255 of Surah Al-Baqarah.

t: Surah Al-Falaq and Surah An-Nas seek refuge in Allah.
f: Surah Al-Falaq and Surah An-Nas are about the battle of Badr.
x: Both surahs begin, "Say: I seek refuge."

t: Surah At-Tawbah does not begin with the basmalah.
f: Surah Al-Fatihah does not begin with the basmalah.
x: At-Tawbah is the only surah that does not open with the basmalah.

t: The Prophet ﷺ passed away in Madinah.
f: The Prophet ﷺ passed away in Makkah.
x: He passed away in Madinah, in the room of Aishah.

t: Masjid an-Nabawi is in Madinah.
f: Masjid an-Nabawi is in Makkah.
x: The Prophet's Mosque is in Madinah.

t: Masjid Quba is in Madinah.
f: Masjid Quba is in Ta'if.
x: Quba is on the edge of Madinah. The Prophet ﷺ visited it every Saturday.

t: Masjid al-Aqsa is in Jerusalem.
f: Masjid al-Aqsa is in Damascus.
x: Masjid al-Aqsa is in Jerusalem.

t: The Isra was the journey from Makkah to Jerusalem by night.
f: The Isra was the journey from Makkah to Madinah by day.
x: Surah Al-Isra describes the night journey from the Inviolable Mosque to the Far Mosque.

t: The five daily prayers were made obligatory on the Mi'raj.
f: The five daily prayers were made obligatory at Badr.
x: The prayers were prescribed on the night of the Mi'raj.

t: The Battle of Badr was in the month of Ramadan.
f: The Battle of Badr was in the month of Muharram.
x: Badr was fought in Ramadan, 2 AH.

t: Makkah was conquered in 8 AH.
f: Makkah was conquered in 2 AH.
x: The conquest of Makkah was in Ramadan, 8 AH. Badr was in 2 AH.

t: The Prophet ﷺ performed Hajj once.
f: The Prophet ﷺ performed Hajj ten times.
x: Anas said he performed Hajj once.

t: Saying "Bismillah" is sunnah before eating.
f: Saying "Bismillah" is sunnah only after eating.
x: The Prophet ﷺ told a boy, "Say Bismillah and eat with your right hand."

t: Eating with the right hand is sunnah.
f: Eating with the left hand is sunnah.
x: The Prophet ﷺ said, "Eat with your right hand."

t: Muslims greet each other with "As-salamu alaykum".
f: Muslims greet each other with "Allahu Akbar".
x: The greeting of Islam is salam.

t: "Alhamdulillah" is said after sneezing.
f: "Astaghfirullah" is said after sneezing.
x: The Prophet ﷺ said, "When one of you sneezes, let him say Alhamdulillah."

t: Smiling at your brother is a charity.
f: Smiling at your brother is makruh.
x: The Prophet ﷺ said, "Your smiling in the face of your brother is charity."

t: The Prophet ﷺ named the mother three times as the most deserving of good company.
f: The Prophet ﷺ named the father three times as the most deserving of good company.
x: Asked who most deserves good company, he said "your mother" three times, then "your father".

t: Lying is a sign of a hypocrite.
f: Smiling is a sign of a hypocrite.
x: The Prophet ﷺ said the signs of a hypocrite are lying, breaking promises and betraying trust.

t: The Prophet ﷺ said actions are judged by intentions.
f: The Prophet ﷺ said actions are judged only by their results.
x: The first hadith in al-Bukhari: actions are by intentions.

t: Angels are created from light.
f: Angels are created from clay.
x: The Prophet ﷺ said angels were created from light, jinn from smokeless fire, and Adam from what was described to you.

t: Jinn are created from smokeless fire.
f: Jinn are created from light.
x: Allah says He created the jinn from smokeless fire.

t: Adam was created from clay.
f: Adam was created from fire.
x: Allah created man from clay. Iblis boasted that he was made of fire.

t: Muharram is the first month of the Islamic year.
f: Ramadan is the first month of the Islamic year.
x: Muharram opens the year. Ramadan is the ninth month.

t: Ramadan is the ninth month of the Islamic year.
f: Ramadan is the twelfth month of the Islamic year.
x: Ramadan is the ninth month. Dhul-Hijjah is the twelfth.

t: There are four sacred months.
f: There are six sacred months.
x: Allah says that of the twelve months, four are sacred.

t: The Islamic year has twelve months.
f: The Islamic year has thirteen months.
x: Allah says the number of months with Him is twelve.

t: Ashura is on the 10th of Muharram.
f: Ashura is on the 10th of Ramadan.
x: Ashura is the tenth of Muharram.

t: The day of Arafah is the 9th of Dhul-Hijjah.
f: The day of Arafah is the 1st of Shawwal.
x: Pilgrims stand at Arafah on the 9th of Dhul-Hijjah, the day before Eid al-Adha.

t: Tawaf is walking around the Ka'bah seven times.
f: Tawaf is walking around the Ka'bah three times.
x: Tawaf is seven circuits around the Ka'bah.

t: Sa'i is walking between Safa and Marwah.
f: Sa'i is walking between Mina and Arafah.
x: Sa'i is between Safa and Marwah.

t: Pilgrims stone the Jamarat at Mina.
f: Pilgrims stone the Jamarat at Arafah.
x: The stoning of the Jamarat takes place in Mina.

t: Ihram is the sacred state entered before Hajj or Umrah.
f: Ihram is the meal eaten after Hajj.
x: Pilgrims enter ihram at the miqat before Hajj or Umrah.

t: Umrah can be performed at any time of the year.
f: Umrah can only be performed in Ramadan.
x: Umrah has no fixed season. The Prophet ﷺ said Umrah in Ramadan equals a Hajj in reward.

t: Zakat is paid on wealth held for a full lunar year.
f: Zakat is paid on wealth held for a single day.
x: Zakat is due on savings above the nisab held for a lunar year.

t: Zakat al-Fitr is given before the Eid prayer.
f: Zakat al-Fitr is given at the end of Dhul-Hijjah.
x: The Prophet ﷺ ordered zakat al-fitr to be paid before people go out to the Eid prayer.

t: Charity does not decrease wealth.
f: The Prophet ﷺ said charity always decreases wealth.
x: The Prophet ﷺ said, "Charity does not decrease wealth."

t: The adhan is the call to prayer.
f: The adhan is the call to break the fast only.
x: The adhan announces the time of every obligatory prayer.

t: "Prayer is better than sleep" is said in the adhan of Fajr.
f: "Prayer is better than sleep" is said in the adhan of Isha.
x: The phrase is added to the Fajr adhan.

t: Ruku' is bowing in the prayer.
f: Ruku' is prostrating in the prayer.
x: Ruku' is bowing. Prostrating is sujud.

t: The prayer ends with the taslim.
f: The prayer ends with the iqamah.
x: The prayer begins with takbir and ends with taslim.

t: A Muslim is told to be good to his neighbour.
f: A Muslim is told to stay away from his neighbour.
x: The Prophet ﷺ said Jibril kept urging him to treat neighbours well.

t: The Prophet ﷺ said the strong person controls himself when angry.
f: The Prophet ﷺ said the strong person is the one who wins wrestling matches.
x: He said the strong one is not the good wrestler but the one who controls himself in anger.

t: Muslims believe in all the prophets.
f: Muslims believe only in Muhammad ﷺ and no earlier prophet.
x: Believers make no distinction between any of Allah's messengers.

t: Belief in the angels is one of the articles of faith.
f: Belief in the angels is not part of faith.
x: In the hadith of Jibril, faith includes belief in Allah, His angels, books, messengers, the Last Day and qadar.

t: The Prophet ﷺ was an orphan.
f: The Prophet's father lived until he became a prophet.
x: His father Abdullah died young, and Allah reminds him, "Did He not find you an orphan?"

t: Abu Talib was the Prophet's uncle.
f: Abu Talib was the Prophet's grandfather.
x: Abu Talib was his uncle. His grandfather was Abd al-Muttalib.

t: Fatimah was the daughter of the Prophet ﷺ.
f: Fatimah was the sister of the Prophet ﷺ.
x: Fatimah was his daughter.

t: Hasan and Husayn were grandsons of the Prophet ﷺ.
f: Hasan and Husayn were uncles of the Prophet ﷺ.
x: They were his grandsons, the sons of Ali and Fatimah.

t: The Qur'an was revealed in Arabic.
f: The Qur'an was revealed in Persian.
x: Allah says, "We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur'an."

t: The Qur'an was revealed over about 23 years.
f: The Qur'an was revealed in a single day.
x: It was revealed in stages over about twenty-three years.

t: Allah promised to preserve the Qur'an.
f: The Qur'an says it will be changed over time.
x: Allah says, "We have sent down the Reminder and We will preserve it."

t: The Ka'bah was rebuilt by Quraysh when the Prophet ﷺ was young.
f: The Ka'bah was first built by Quraysh.
x: Ibrahim and Isma'il raised its foundations. Quraysh rebuilt it in the Prophet's youth.

t: Uthman ibn Affan was the third caliph.
f: Uthman ibn Affan was the first caliph.
x: Uthman was the third caliph, after Abu Bakr and Umar.

t: Umar ibn al-Khattab was the second caliph.
f: Umar ibn al-Khattab was the fourth caliph.
x: Umar was the second caliph. Ali was the fourth.

t: Surah Ar-Rahman repeats "Which of the favours of your Lord will you deny?"
f: Surah Al-Baqarah repeats "Which of the favours of your Lord will you deny?" many times.
x: This refrain runs through Surah Ar-Rahman.

t: Surah Al-Kahf tells the story of the People of the Cave.
f: Surah Al-Kahf tells the story of the People of the Elephant.
x: Al-Kahf tells of the sleepers in the cave. Al-Fil tells of the elephant.

t: Surah Al-Fil tells of the army of the elephant.
f: Surah Al-Fil tells of Nuh's flood.
x: Surah Al-Fil tells how Allah dealt with the people of the elephant.

t: Surah Maryam is named after the mother of Isa.
f: Surah Maryam is named after the mother of Musa.
x: Maryam was the mother of Isa.
